outcome: KRAS (Kirsten Rat Sarcoma Viral Oncogene) mutations
cohort: The study included 210 infants and children who underwent resectional surgery for antenatally-detected Congenital Pulmonary Airway Malformation (CPAM) at a single center between 1994 and 2020.
finding: This series highlights a clear association between type 1 CPAM and mucinous adenocarcinoma with KRAS point mutations, suggesting the potential for carcinogenesis to start in utero.
